name: Todd V Dating — The System
what_it_is: Structured dating course for men (The System) with frameworks for approaching/conversation, plus bootcamps and a mentorship with weekly calls and field-report assignments.
notes: Seed. Field assignments = real-world exercises; curriculum breakdowns exist in third-party reviews.

name: Matthew Dicks — Storyworthy / Storyworthy Workshops
what_it_is: 57-time Moth champion teaching storytelling via book (Storyworthy), Zoom workshops, and exercises like Homework for Life, Crash & Burn, First/Last/Best/Worst.
notes: Richest named-exercise source in storytelling domain; exercises documented in book and blog.

name: Greg Dean — Stand-Up Comedy Classes
what_it_is: Veteran teacher of 'Step by Step to Stand-Up Comedy'; joke structure system (setup/punch, reforges) taught via book, online courses, LA classes.
notes: Seed. Most codified joke-mechanics system (joke map, 4 reforge techniques).

name: The Art of Charm
what_it_is: Social-skills company with podcast, online programs (X-Factor) and week-long residential bootcamps covering conversation, networking, confidence.
notes: Seed. Podcast includes drills/toolbox episodes; bootcamp curriculum described in reviews.

name: Judy Carter — Comedy Bible workshops
what_it_is: Comedy teacher/author (The New Comedy Bible) with workbook of 48 exercises and live workshops; alumni include Hannah Gadsby, Seth Rogen.
notes: Workbook = 48 named exercises + 30 prompts; day-by-day bootcamp structure in book.
